title: Recovering Kodaira types from $\ell$-torsion on elliptic curves
summary: The classical Néron-Ogg-Shafarevich criterion characterises good reduction of an elliptic curve $E$ over a $p$-adic field via the action of inertia on the $\ell$-adic Tate module. However, the action of inertia on $E[\ell]$ is not sufficient to distinguish between potentially good and multiplicative reduction, and the action on $T_{\ell}(E)$ is not sufficient to determine the Kodaira type. We remedy this situation by endowing $E[\ell]$ with a distance function that records the $p$-adic distances between the $x$-coordinates of the points.
